role: A named custom payload channel; in 1.7.10 the server sends MC|TrList (the villager's trade list) and book editing channels.
scope_reason: Villager trading is in scope, so the MC|TrList payload is too; the native engine builds and applies it as its own packet kind.

members.name: S3FPacketCustomPayload
members.note: the decoder's ctor only: Packet.generatePacket instantiates it by reflection (newInstance) for bytes read off a socket (MessageDeserializer); the integrated server's local channel passes packet objects with no codec (NetworkManager.provideLocalClient adds only the packet_handler), so it never runs

members.name: S3FPacketCustomPayload
members.note: the only payload the native engine builds is MC|TrList, the villager's trade list, filled into struct s2c_pkt.ntrlist; the 1 MiB guard has no counterpart

members.name: field_149172_a
members.note: the channel string is replaced by the packet kind PK_S3F

members.name: field_149171_b
members.note: the payload is struct s2c_pkt's ntrlist recipe array, the only channel implemented

members.name: processPacket
members.note: the PK_S3F case applies MC|TrList to the merchant screen's recipe list, only while that window is open and the window id matches

notes: EntityPlayerMP.displayGUIMerchant opens the window and sends the S2D, the S3F MC|TrList and the first per slot S2Fs (survival.c:2737). Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): wire format and connection plumbing: native messages are structs by design (SPEC: messages are structs, not bytes). Formerly listed as missing: readPacketData/writePacketData: no byte codec; the native packet is a struct the other server to client channels: book editing (MC|BEdit, MC|BSign) is switched off (world.conf book_editing = off) and no other channel is sent in this game lane/villagetrade 2026-09-27: the tail-only evidence (X-01/X-02) now points at the full re-records trade-full-s1, whose native replay starts before the behaviour.
